IN.message: Indian numbers must be 10 digits and start with 6–9

AE.message: UAE (Dubai) mobile numbers must be 9 digits and start with 5

SG.message: Singapore numbers must be 8 digits and start with 8 or 9

SA.message: Saudi mobile numbers must be 9 digits and start with 5

PK.message: Pakistan mobile numbers must be 10 digits and start with 3

BD.message: Bangladesh numbers must be 10–11 digits and start with 01

NP.message: Nepal numbers must be 10 digits and start with 9

LK.message: Sri Lanka mobile numbers must be 9 digits and start with 7

PH.message: Philippines mobile numbers must be 10 digits and start with 9

MY.message: Malaysia mobile numbers usually start with 1 and are 9–10 digits

ID.message: Indonesian mobile numbers must be 10–12 digits and start with 8

NZ.message: New Zealand mobile numbers must start with 2

TR.message: Turkish mobile numbers must be 10 digits and start with 5

ES.message: Spanish mobile numbers must be 9 digits starting with 6 or 7

US.message: US numbers must be 10 digits and start from 2–9

CA.message: Canada numbers must be 10 digits and start from 2–9

AU.message: Australian mobile numbers must be 9 digits and start with 4

DE.message: German numbers must be 10–11 digits and not start with 0

FR.message: French mobile numbers must be 9 digits and start with 6 or 7

IT.message: Italian mobile numbers must be 10 digits and start with 3

ZA.message: South African numbers must be 9 digits

RU.message: Russian numbers must be 10 digits and not start with 0

CN.message: Chinese mobile numbers must be 11 digits and start with 1
